challenges.name: shipping-fee-calculator
challenges.title: Shipping fees with an enum and a switch expression
challenges.description: Mekong Books receives orders as text lines such as "EXPRESS 3 DN", "standard 1 HCM" or "DRONE 1 HN" (method, weight in kg, region). Write parseMethod(text), which turns the method name into a ShippingMethod constant in any letter case and returns null for an unknown name instead of throwing, and fee(method, kg, region), which computes the fee in VND with a switch expression: STANDARD 20,000 + 5,000 per kg, EXPRESS 35,000 + 10,000 per kg, PICKUP free, and 15,000 extra for STANDARD and EXPRESS outside HN and HCM. The runner prints one line per order, an error line for each unknown method and a summary line with the total.

tests.name: Inner-city orders: STANDARD, EXPRESS and a free PICKUP
tests.input:
STANDARD 2 HN
EXPRESS 1 HCM
PICKUP 4 HN
tests.expected:
STANDARD 2kg HN: 30000
EXPRESS 1kg HCM: 45000
PICKUP 4kg HN: 0
orders: 3, errors: 0, total: 75000

tests.name: Outside HN and HCM adds 15,000; pickup stays free
tests.input:
STANDARD 1 DN
EXPRESS 3 CT
PICKUP 2 DN
tests.expected:
STANDARD 1kg DN: 40000
EXPRESS 3kg CT: 80000
PICKUP 2kg DN: 0
orders: 3, errors: 0, total: 120000

tests.name: Method names in any letter case
tests.input:
express 2 HN
Standard 1 HCM
pickup 1 DN
tests.expected:
EXPRESS 2kg HN: 55000
STANDARD 1kg HCM: 25000
PICKUP 1kg DN: 0
orders: 3, errors: 0, total: 80000

tests.name: Unknown methods give an error line, not a crash
tests.input:
DRONE 1 HN
EXPRES 2 HN
STANDARD 1 HN
tests.expected:
error: unknown method DRONE
error: unknown method EXPRES
STANDARD 1kg HN: 25000
orders: 1, errors: 2, total: 25000

tests.name: Mixed batch with blank lines, extra spaces and an unknown method

express   1   DN 

PICKUP 3 HCM
standard 5 HUE

tests.expected:

PICKUP 3kg HCM: 0
STANDARD 5kg HUE: 60000
error: unknown method Bike
orders: 3, errors: 1, total: 120000
